% Plain TeX's \pmatrix, \matrix, and \cases with braces, which LaTeX keeps
% without amsmath and MathJax knows: cases that a fix for amsmath's macro
% pairs, such as \bmatrix ... \endbmatrix, must not break. Inline, in a
% display, and in a numbered equation. Also a \bmatrix of the document's,
% inline and in the rows of a numbered eqnarray.
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\bmatrix}[1]{\left[\matrix{#1}\right]}
\begin{document}
Inline, $P = \pmatrix{a & b \cr c & d}$ and $Q = \matrix{1 & 2 \cr 3 & 4}$.
In a display:
\[ s = \cases{1 & positive \cr 0 & otherwise} \]
In a numbered equation:
\begin{equation}
R = \pmatrix{x \cr y}
\end{equation}
The document's own, $M = \bmatrix{a & b \cr c & d}$, and in rows:
\begin{eqnarray}
x &=& \bmatrix{1 \cr 2} \\
y &=& 3
\end{eqnarray}
\end{document}
